start_basis: Sec. 1: "There is established the President's Advisory Panel on Federal Tax Reform"; no effective-date clause, so it operates from signing, 2005-01-07 (70 FR 2323, published 2005-01-12).
end_basis: As issued, sec. 7 ended the Panel "30 days after submitting its report pursuant to section 5" (event-relative; sec. 5 deadline July 31, 2005, a deadline only). EO 13386 (signed 2005-09-30, 70 FR 58289) sec. 2 amends sec. 7 by deleting that phrase and inserting "November 15, 2005", so sec. 7 now reads "The Advisory Panel shall terminate November 15, 2005." Stated date, no arithmetic; "terminate [on] November 15, 2005" is read as the end falling on that date, the same convention as Lamm II (EO 12219). The end is as amended, cited to the held text of EO 13386; the original TERM span is event-relative and gives no date by itself.

No held text gives the report date.
